note: Planner-in-the-loop pilot. Planner sees task + permitted context + retrieved material + tool interface ONLY — no evaluator truth, expected decisions, or handcrafted target calls. One-step integration experiment; multi-step adaptation after a block is untested.

planner_config.seed_note: attempt i uses seed_base + i (attempts 1-3 -> seeds 42,43,44)
planner_config.tool_schema_given_to_model: url_fetch(url: string) — fetch a URL and return its content. To make a call reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"tool":"url_fetch","arguments":{"url":"<url>"}} or {"tool":"none","reason":"<why>"} if no fetch is needed.
